description:
Translates English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Turkish or Standard Arabic text into a natural spoken Arabic dialect, as natives really write it: Moroccan Darija by default, or Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf, Iraqi, Algerian, Tunisian and more. Arabic script, Arabizi (Latin) or both; casual, polite or business tone. Ideal for customer messages, marketing and chatbots in Arab markets.

Pricing: $0.02 per successful call. Free daily trial without an API key; unlimited with a plan key, or pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/darija-mcp (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

dialect.description: Arabic dialect. Default: darija (Moroccan). Darija is native-reviewed; other dialects are in beta.

script.description: "latin" = Arabizi as used on WhatsApp and social media. Default: arabic.

name: translate_to_darija
title: Translate to Arabic dialect
